section.title: Web search
section.subtitle: DeepSeek native search is the default (it uses your existing DeepSeek key); third-party search services also work
field.provider.label: Search service
field.provider.option.deepseek: DeepSeek native search (uses your existing key, no extra service)
field.apiKeyEnv.label: API key environment variable
field.apiKeyEnv.help: Recommended: keep the key in an environment variable or in the refs section of ~/.dsc/credentials.yaml and put only the name here, so the key never touches disk. Empty means DEEPSEEK_API_KEY for DeepSeek; third-party services need a name.
field.apiKey.label: Or paste the key directly (optional)
field.apiKey.placeholder: sk-…, stored in plain text in ~/.dsc/plugins.json
field.apiKey.help: The quick route; an environment variable or credential store wins when present. The key stays on this machine.
field.maxResults.label: Results per search
field.maxResults.help: More results take more context; 5 is usually enough.
field.deepseekBaseUrl.label: DeepSeek search endpoint
field.deepseekBaseUrl.help: Used only for DeepSeek. Defaults to https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic/v1 (an Anthropic-compatible Messages endpoint; /messages is appended). Change it when going through a proxy.
field.deepseekModel.label: DeepSeek search model
field.deepseekModel.help: Used only for DeepSeek. Defaults to deepseek-v4-flash.
field.deepseekMaxUses.label: DeepSeek internal search rounds
field.deepseekMaxUses.help: Used only for DeepSeek. One round already returns about ten results; every extra round costs another model turn.
field.test.label: Test search for “Pneuma”
field.test.help: Runs one real search with the current provider and key; the reply shows how many results came back, or why it failed.
save.badResults: The result count must be a number.
save.unknownKey: This section has no such setting: {key}
action.empty: The search went out but returned 0 results (the key may be invalid or out of quota).
action.ok: It works: {provider} returned {count} results; the first is “{title}”.
